from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentCase(BaseModel):
    """Extracted details from a single judgment document for matching purposes."""
    document_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the document (e.g. '判决文书 1'), if available from context")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case: '民事' (Civil) or '刑事' (Criminal)")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the judgment")
    appellants: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Names of the appellants")
    respondents: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Names of the respondents")
    defendants: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Names of the defendants (if criminal case)")
    case_subject: str | None = Field(description="Brief summary of the dispute or key legal subject, e.g. '公房使用权', '毒品'")
    ruling_summary: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the court's ruling, e.g. '驳回上诉，维持原判' or specific sentencing details")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[JudgmentCase]
